about: Every TestCord, Equicord and Vencord plugin ships in MochaCord except the ones below: duplicates where a better plugin does the same job, and plugins that cannot work or break voice in MochaCord. Remove a name to bring it back.

drop.BetterGifLoad: FastGifPicker already lightens the GIF picker
drop.BigFileUpload: Uploads go through the desktop helpers, which MochaCord does not have
drop.BigFileUploadEnhanced: Says itself that it needs Discord Desktop
drop.BlockKrisp: Krisp only exists in the Discord desktop app
drop.CloseAllDms: ChatsScrapper already closes DMs, with a whitelist
drop.FollowVoiceUser: FollowUser does the same with more options
drop.FollowVoiceUser-Extand: Copy of FollowVoiceUser; FollowUser covers both
drop.GoofcordSecurity: Forces voice through relay servers, which leaves calls stuck on RTC Connecting
drop.GpuBinder: Edits the Windows registry for the Discord desktop app; does nothing in MochaCord
drop.HyprTilesPremium: Only a settings shim for HyprTiles
drop.MessageLoggerEnhanced: MessageLoggerTestcord already merges its features (edit history, ghost pings)
drop.UserpluginInstaller: Needs git and the desktop helpers; MochaCord ships its plugins in the build
drop.WebCordHardened: Forces voice through relay servers, which leaves calls stuck on RTC Connecting
drop.WebPWA: Installs Discord as a browser app; MochaCord already is one, and its badge call threw errors
drop.WebRTCLeakPrevent: Forces voice through relay servers, which leaves calls stuck on RTC Connecting
